desc: The only reliable semi-automatic air rifle on the market today, the new 1077 is pure shooting excitement. It features Crosman's patented 12-shot rotary clip for true semi-automatic action. Fires as fast as you can pull the trigger. Rifled steel barrel and fully adjustable rear sights. Reliable CO2 power for velocity to 625 fps. Scope-ready receiver. Synthetic or walnut stock.
